# Field reference

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by backend/scripts/gen_docs.py — do not edit by hand. -->

Data fields are the leaves of an alpha expression. Price/volume and derived fields are always available; fundamentals, macro, and GICS grouping fields depend on the deployment's data coverage.

## Price

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `open` | Opening price |
| `high` | Daily high price |
| `low` | Daily low price |
| `close` | Closing price |
| `volume` | Daily share volume |
| `returns` | Daily simple return (close.pct_change) |
| `vwap` | Typical price (high + low + close) / 3 |

## Price structure

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `median_price` | Average of high and low; cleaner price estimate than close |
| `weighted_close` | Close-weighted typical price; smoother than simple average |
| `range_` | High minus low; daily volatility proxy (alias: range) |
| `body` | Absolute candle body size; small body indicates indecision |
| `upper_shadow` | Rejection of higher prices; potential bearish signal |
| `lower_shadow` | Rejection of lower prices; potential bullish signal |
| `gap` | Overnight price gap; captures after-hours sentiment |
| `range_z_20` | Z-score of today's range vs its 20-day distribution |
| `body_to_range` | \|close-open\| / range; small body = indecision day |
| `consecutive_up` | Consecutive up-day streak; resets on any down day |
| `consecutive_down` | Consecutive down-day streak; resets on any up day |

## Return variants

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `log_returns` | Log of price ratio; symmetric and better for compounding |
| `abs_returns` | Absolute daily return; volatility proxy |
| `intraday_return` | Close minus open over open; pure intraday momentum |
| `overnight_return` | Open minus prior close; captures news/earnings reaction |
| `signed_volume` | Volume signed by return direction; money flow proxy |

## Volume liquidity

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `dollar_volume` | Price times volume; true liquidity measure |
| `adv20` | 20-day average daily volume; liquidity baseline |
| `volume_ratio` | Volume divided by adv20; values above 1 indicate unusual activity |
| `amihud` | Absolute return over dollar volume; Amihud illiquidity ratio |

## Volatility risk

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `true_range` | Volatility accounting for gaps; better than simple high-low range |
| `atr` | 14-day average true range; standard volatility measure |
| `realized_vol` | 20-day rolling return standard deviation |
| `skewness` | 60-day rolling return skewness; negative values indicate crash risk |
| `kurtosis` | 60-day rolling return kurtosis; high values indicate fat tails |
| `realized_vol_5` | 5-day rolling return standard deviation |
| `realized_vol_60` | 60-day rolling return standard deviation |
| `realized_vol_120` | 120-day rolling return standard deviation |
| `vol_of_vol_20` | 20-day stdev of realized_vol_20; vol-regime change proxy |
| `parkinson_vol` | Range-based vol estimator using high-low; more efficient than close-to-close |
| `garman_klass_vol` | OHLC-based vol estimator; combines intraday extremes and gap |
| `atr_5` | 5-day average true range; short-window vol via TR |
| `atr_60` | 60-day average true range; long-window vol via TR |

## Momentum relative

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `momentum_5` | 5-day price momentum |
| `momentum_20` | 20-day price momentum |
| `close_to_high_252` | Ratio of close to 52-week high; distance from recent peak |
| `high_low_ratio` | High over low; intraday volatility as a ratio |
| `momentum_3` | 3-day price momentum |
| `momentum_10` | 10-day price momentum |
| `momentum_60` | 60-day (3-month) price momentum |
| `momentum_120` | 120-day (6-month) price momentum |
| `momentum_252` | 252-day (1-year) price momentum |
| `reversal_5` | Negative of momentum_5; short-horizon mean-reversion signal |
| `reversal_20` | Negative of momentum_20; mid-horizon mean-reversion signal |
| `momentum_z_60` | 60-day momentum / 60-day return-vol; risk-adjusted momentum |

## Microstructure

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `roll_spread` | Roll's effective spread (1984): 2·sqrt(-cov(Δp_t, Δp_{t-1})) |
| `kyle_lambda` | Kyle's lambda price-impact proxy: \|returns\| / sqrt(dollar_volume) |
| `vpin_proxy` | Order-flow toxicity: \|signed_volume\| / total_volume, rolling 20 |
| `up_volume_ratio` | Fraction of 20-day volume traded on green days |
| `down_volume_ratio` | Fraction of 20-day volume traded on red days |
| `turnover_ratio` | Today's volume vs. 60-day baseline; long-horizon volume_ratio |
| `dollar_amihud` | Smoothed \|returns\| / dollar_volume; per-dollar-volume price impact |
| `corwin_schultz` | Corwin-Schultz (2012) high-low spread estimator |

## Macro

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `vix` | CBOE VIX index — implied vol of S&P 500 options |
| `treasury_3m_yield` | 3-month Treasury constant-maturity yield (%) |
| `treasury_2y_yield` | 2-year Treasury constant-maturity yield (%) |
| `treasury_10y_yield` | 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield (%) |
| `term_spread_10y_2y` | 10y minus 2y Treasury spread; recession indicator |
| `term_spread_10y_3m` | 10y minus 3m Treasury spread; classic curve inversion gauge |
| `high_yield_spread` | ICE BofA US High Yield Index option-adjusted spread |
| `baa_yield` | Moody's seasoned Baa corporate bond yield (%) |
| `aaa_yield` | Moody's seasoned Aaa corporate bond yield (%) |
| `credit_spread_baa_aaa` | Baa minus Aaa corporate spread; credit-stress proxy |
| `dxy` | Broad trade-weighted USD index |
| `wti_oil` | WTI crude oil spot price (USD/bbl) |

## Fundamentals

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `revenue` | Quarterly total revenue (lagged 1Q) |
| `gross_profit` | Quarterly gross profit |
| `operating_income` | Quarterly operating income |
| `net_income` | Quarterly net income |
| `ebitda` | Quarterly EBITDA |
| `eps` | Diluted earnings per share (quarterly) |
| `total_assets` | Balance sheet total assets |
| `total_debt` | Balance sheet total debt |
| `total_equity` | Balance sheet total stockholders equity (book value) |
| `cash` | Cash and cash equivalents |
| `current_assets` | Total current assets |
| `current_liabilities` | Total current liabilities |
| `operating_cash_flow` | Cash from operating activities |
| `capex` | Capital expenditure (negative in yfinance) |
| `free_cash_flow` | OCF + capex (or yfinance-supplied) |

## Fundamentals ratio

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `pe_ratio` | Price-to-earnings: market_cap / net_income |
| `pb_ratio` | Price-to-book: market_cap / total_equity |
| `ps_ratio` | Price-to-sales: market_cap / revenue |
| `ev_ebitda` | Enterprise value / EBITDA |
| `roe` | Return on equity: net_income / total_equity |
| `roa` | Return on assets: net_income / total_assets |
| `debt_to_equity` | Total debt / total equity |
| `current_ratio` | Current assets / current liabilities |
| `gross_margin` | Gross profit / revenue |
| `operating_margin` | Operating income / revenue |
| `net_margin` | Net income / revenue |
| `fcf_yield` | Free cash flow / market cap |
| `earnings_yield` | Net income / market cap (inverse of P/E) |
| `dividend_yield` | Trailing dividends paid / market cap |
| `shares_outstanding` | Implied shares from net_income / EPS (per-day, forward-filled) |

## Fundamentals

Lagged ~1 quarter as a point-in-time proxy. Availability depends on the deployment's fundamentals coverage.

`revenue`, `gross_profit`, `operating_income`, `net_income`, `ebitda`, `eps`, `total_assets`, `total_debt`, `total_equity`, `cash`, `current_assets`, `current_liabilities`, `operating_cash_flow`, `capex`, `free_cash_flow`, `dividends_paid`, `pe_ratio`, `pb_ratio`, `ps_ratio`, `ev_ebitda`, `roe`, `roa`, `debt_to_equity`, `current_ratio`, `gross_margin`, `operating_margin`, `net_margin`, `fcf_yield`, `earnings_yield`, `dividend_yield`, `shares_outstanding`

## Sector / industry grouping

Categorical fields passed as the grouping argument to the `group_*` operators (e.g. `group_neutralize(x, sector)`):

`sector`, `industry_group`, `industry`, `sub_industry`
